title: Mission: The Tricycle
activityInstruction: Count the wheels, push the pedals six times, then stop at the finish. Watch how the pedals and front wheel turn together in the diagram.

storyQuestions.success: The children went to the park.
The blond boy wanted to ride.

storyQuestions.prompt: How many wheels does the bicycle have?
What happened when he tried to ride?

storyQuestions.success: No, the bicycle did not stay balanced.

storyQuestions.prompt: What can we add to help?
How many wheels will it have?
What do we call a three-wheeled bicycle?
storyQuestions.success: A three-wheeled bicycle is a tricycle.
The pedals make its wheels turn.

storyQuestions.prompt: What are we going to build?
storyQuestions.success: We are going to build a tricycle.

parts.label: Wheels
parts.fact: A tricycle has three wheels: one at the front and two at the back.

parts.label: Pedals
parts.fact: Your feet push the pedals. On this kind of tricycle, they turn the front wheel.

parts.label: Handlebars
parts.fact: Turn the handlebars to point the front wheel and steer.

parts.label: Seat
parts.fact: The seat supports the rider while their feet push the pedals.

exploreInstruction: Drag to turn the real model. Find one front wheel and two rear wheels. Look for the seat, handlebars and pedals. Which part helps the rider steer?
